80293.subject: Treasury Drops Its Crypto Wallet Surveillance Rules
80293.body:
**gm, Defiers!**

These are the biggest stories in DeFi and crypto:

* **[FinCEN](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/treasury-drops-crypto-wallet-surveillance-rules)**[ withdrew its unhosted-wallet reporting rule and its finding that crypto mixing is a laundering concern](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/treasury-drops-crypto-wallet-surveillance-rules)

* **[The CFTC](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/cftc-seeks-comment-crypto-rulebook-leaves-spot-exchanges-to-states-oct-05-2026)**[ opened an elective federal rulebook for exchanges offering retail crypto leverage](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/cftc-seeks-comment-crypto-rulebook-leaves-spot-exchanges-to-states-oct-05-2026)

* **[ZachXBT](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/zachxbt-infiltrated-chinese-syndicate-laundering-bybit-hack-funds)**[ spent weeks posing as a client of a Chinese syndicate laundering Bybit funds for North Korea](https://thedefiant.io/news/hacks/zachxbt-infiltrated-chinese-syndicate-laundering-bybit-hack-funds)

* **[OKX and ICE](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/okx-ice-plans-tokenized-stock-trading-through-a-uniswap-v4-hook)**[ will trade tokenized stocks in permissioned Uniswap v4 pools on X Layer](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/okx-ice-plans-tokenized-stock-trading-through-a-uniswap-v4-hook)

* **[S&P Global](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/s-p-global-puts-a-letter-grade-on-defi-lending-vaults)**[ started grading DeFi lending vaults, with the curator's score capping the result](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/s-p-global-puts-a-letter-grade-on-defi-lending-vaults)

FinCEN published its unhosted-wallet reporting rule on Dec. 23, 2020 and gave the public until Jan. 4 to comment. Twelve days, most of them holidays. The rule drew 7,685 comments anyway, the mixing proposal that followed in 2023 drew 2,239, and both then sat unfinished — one of them for five and a half years.

On Monday the bureau [withdrew them both](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/treasury-drops-crypto-wallet-surveillance-rules), ending the rulemakings with no final rule. Hours later the CFTC [opened a rulemaking of its own](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/cftc-seeks-comment-crypto-rulebook-leaves-spot-exchanges-to-states-oct-05-2026) that would pull exchanges offering retail leverage under a federal regime and leave ordinary spot venues to state money transmission law. The same day, OKX's joint venture with NYSE owner Intercontinental Exchange [filed to trade 63 tokenized U.S. stocks](https://thedefiant.io/news/defi/okx-ice-plans-tokenized-stock-trading-through-a-uniswap-v4-hook) in permissioned Uniswap v4 pools, the first venue to use the SEC's September exemption.

The Senate [blocked the CLARITY Act 49-50 on Sept. 15](https://thedefiant.io/news/regulation/senate-blocks-clarity-act-49-50-with-no-democratic-votes-to-proceed). 80291.body:
The Monthly AI Recap

Автор: Google


Автор: Google

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn

September's headline belongs to Gemini 4 Argon, our newest frontier model. Built with advanced reasoning and a 1-million-token output limit, it’s designed to tackle complex challenges — especially in cybersecurity defense. The release capped an active month for launches that included Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber. We also introduced expressive voice models with Gemini 3.8 Live, made Googlebook available for pre-order, and brought the Gemini app to Windows. Beyond daily tools, we marked major scientific milestones by mapping human DNA in AlphaGenome Atlas, tracking global methane from space, and launching Project Suncatcher to test machine learning hardware in orbit. As a nice bonus, we were recognized by Fast Company as the 2026 Design Company of the Year for our work designing better AI interfaces. Learn about Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence. Gemini 4 Argon is engineered to bring advanced reasoning to the most difficult of problems. Built with an industry-leading 1-million-token output limit, Argon excels at heavy-duty workloads like coding, cybersecurity defense, and knowledge work like financial research and legal drafting, and autonomous cybersecurity patching. Safely releasing frontier capabilities at this level requires a phased approach, and Argon is currently rolling out to trusted cyber defenders through the Fairwind Program. We’re actively gathering feedback from early testers to iterate on guardrails before expanding availability to developers, enterprises, and consumers. Get next-gen intelligence for agents and cybersecurity with Gemini 3.8 Flash and 3.8 Flash Cyber. Gemini 3.8 delivers our best reasoning and coding performance yet at the same speed and low cost as 3.7 Flash. Gemini 3.8 Flash provides substantial gains in long-horizon software engineering, multi-step problem solving, and agentic workflows. Alongside it, Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber equips defenders with frontier-grade autonomous vulnerability discovery and automated code patching — available to trusted organizations through our new Fairwind Program. Converse naturally with Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking. We've launched two of our most advanced, native audio models yet: Gemini 3.8 Live for everyday conversation, and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, our most intelligent speech model yet for multi-step reasoning.
